activities.title: Travel to Assam State Museum
activities.description: Auto‑rickshaw ride from your hotel (near Guwahati Railway Station) to the Assam State Museum (≈2.4 km, ~3 min drive).

activities.title: Assam State Museum
activities.description: Explore the museum’s collections on Assamese history, culture and art. Entry fee ≈ 20 INR per person.

activities.title: Travel to Kachari Ghat (boat jetty)
activities.description: Auto‑rickshaw ride to the Brahmaputra riverbank where boats to Umananda Island depart.

activities.title: Boat to Umananda Island
activities.description: Short river crossing to Umananda (Peacock) Island. Boat fare ≈ 30 INR per person each way.

activities.title: Umananda Temple visit
activities.description: Visit the small Shiva temple on the world’s smallest inhabited river island.

activities.title: Return boat to riverbank
activities.description: Boat ride back to the mainland.

activities.title: Lunch at Paradise Biryani House
activities.description: Enjoy a mid‑range Assamese‑style biryani meal. Estimated cost ≈ 400 INR per person.

activities.title: Brahmaputra Riverfront walk
activities.description: Leisurely stroll along the riverfront promenade, with views of the Brahmaputra and local life.

activities.title: Kamakhya Temple
activities.description: Visit the famous Kamakhya Temple, a major Shakti shrine. No entry fee.

activities.title: Return to hotel
activities.description: Auto‑rickshaw ride back to your accommodation.
